title: PRD handoffd daemon (heartbeat + watch process)
objective: PRD §6/§7.2 architecture has a Daemon node that is unrealized — there is no handoffd process. Build the daemon: lease-heartbeat ticker, ledger tail/watch feed (the read-model behind hf watch / Mission Control), and a supervised resume hook, so the loop has a live process, not only one-shot CLI invocations.
acceptance_criteria: PRD handoffd daemon (heartbeat + watch process): implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
